output:
A bit of honest news from me, and some good news too.

Priya Bhatia joins us on Monday 16 November. She’s a chartered structural engineer (IStructE) with nine years’ experience at a consultancy in Coventry, and I’m genuinely delighted to have her on the team. With Priya on board, our target for beam calculations and drawings is now **10 working days**.

I also want to acknowledge that the last couple of months haven’t been good enough. In September and October, turnaround stretched to five or six weeks, and several clients waited far too long. One couple in Harborne had their builder waiting with the steel ordered. We got their calculations to them in three days, but only after they’d chased us twice. I’m sorry they—and others—had to wait, and I understand why one client left a sharp review.

The slow weeks were my fault. I said yes to too much work on my own. In October I was doing site visits by day and calculations until midnight; my wife even started calling the office “the other house”. That isn’t an excuse, just an honest explanation. I’m glad we’re making a change so clients aren’t left waiting like that.

For anyone waiting now: your job is moving, and you’re welcome to message me directly for an update.

There’s also a change to site visits. From **1 January 2027**, a first site visit will cost **£95**. If you go ahead with the work, that £95 will be deducted from your fee. Any visit already booked when this post goes live will remain free, whatever date it’s scheduled for. The free visit has been useful, but about a third didn’t lead to a job, so this change will help us make better use of our time.

Please join me in welcoming Priya. And if you see her on site, do say hello!
